title: Mayo-Marinated Chicken With Chimichurri
description: Juicy grilled or pan-seared chicken cutlets marinated in a mayonnaise-based chimichurri blend for even coating, enhanced browning, and bold herb flavor, served with fresh chimichurri sauce.

ingredients.name: chicken breast cutlets
ingredients.quantity: 4 cutlets (4–5 oz each), pounded to ~1/4-inch thick

ingredients.name: chimichurri
ingredients.quantity: 1 cup total (1/4 cup for marinade + remaining for serving)

steps.instruction: Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt and pepper.
Whisk mayonnaise with 1/4 cup chimichurri in a bowl.
Add chicken and coat thoroughly. Marinate immediately or refrigerate 4–24 hours.
Grill over high heat for 4–5 minutes total until lightly charred and cooked through.
OR cook in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for about 4 minutes, flipping and swirling until browned and cooked through.
Transfer to a plate and spoon reserved chimichurri over the chicken.
